title: RBI Extends Recovery Norms Deadline and Eases Certification Timeline
description: <cite index="33-2">The RBI revised directions on loan recovery and engagement of recovery agents would now be effective on January 1, 2027, extending it from the earlier proposed October 1, 2026.</cite> <cite index="33-3">The RBI allowed regulated entities a one-year window to ensure their recovery agents obtain required certifications.</cite>
